components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; height:36px; padding:0 12px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:var(--color-surface, #fff); color:var(--color-ink, oklch(20.5% 0 0)); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--color-line, oklch(14.5% 0 0 / 0.1)); font-family: 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.16px; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; transition:background-color 150ms; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--color-recessed, oklch(96.5% 0 0)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, oklch(57.72% 0.2324 260)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Toolbar Search
components.description: 36px search field with the 0.45 control line.
components.css: .ds-search { position:relative; display:block; width:320px; } .ds-search-icon { position:absolute; left:10px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); color:var(--color-muted, oklch(55.6% 0 0)); display:flex; pointer-events:none; } .ds-search-input { width:100%; height:36px; padding:0 12px 0 32px; border:0; border-radius:8px; background:var(--color-surface, #fff); color:var(--color-ink, oklch(20.5% 0 0)); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--color-line-control, oklch(14.5% 0 0 / 0.45)); font-family: 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.16px; font-size:14px; caret-color:var(--color-primary, oklch(57.72% 0.2324 260)); outline:none; box-sizing:border-box; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color:var(--color-muted, oklch(55.6% 0 0)); opacity:1; } .ds-search-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, oklch(57.72% 0.2324 260)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; width:224px; padding:12px 8px; background:var(--color-canvas, oklch(98.75% 0 0)); } .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; height:32px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:8px; color:var(--color-label, oklch(43.9% 0 0)); text-decoration:none; font-family: 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.16px; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; transition:background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-nav-item svg { opacity:.6; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:var(--color-recessed, oklch(96.5% 0 0)); color:var(--color-strong, oklch(14.5% 0 0)); } .ds-nav-item:hover svg, .ds-active svg { opacity:1; } .ds-active, .ds-active:hover { background:var(--color-surface, #fff); color:var(--color-strong, oklch(14.5% 0 0)); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--color-line, oklch(14.5% 0 0 / 0.1)); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, oklch(57.72% 0.2324 260)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-table { background:var(--color-surface, #fff); border-radius:8px 8px 0 0; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--color-line, oklch(14.5% 0 0 / 0.1)); overflow:hidden; } .ds-table table { width:560px; border-collapse:collapse; text-align:left; font-family: 'Inter Variable', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.16px; font-size:14px; color:var(--color-ink, oklch(20.5% 0 0)); } .ds-table th { height:40px; padding:0 12px; font-weight:600; color:var(--color-strong, oklch(14.5% 0 0)); border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-fill, oklch(92.2% 0 0)); } .ds-table td { height:40px; padding:0 12px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--color-fill, oklch(92.2% 0 0)); } .ds-table tbody tr { transition:background-color 100ms; cursor:pointer; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background:var(--color-recessed, oklch(96.5% 0 0)); } .ds-num { text-align:right; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-name { font-weight:500; color:var(--color-strong, oklch(14.5% 0 0)); } .ds-token, .ds-empty { font-size:13px; color:var(--color-muted, oklch(55.6% 0 0)); } .ds-dot { display:inline-block; width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:9999px; margin-right:6px; background:var(--color-success, oklch(59.6% 0.145 163.2)); } .ds-dot-b { background:oklch(54.6% 0.245 262.9); }

components.name: Term Ribbon
components.description: Signature 12-month strip: blue renewal ticks, hollow X-date rings, strong 2px today marker, warning inside 30 days.
components.css: .ds-ribbon { position:relative; display:block; width:120px; height:20px; } .ds-ribbon > span { position:absolute; } .ds-rb-band { top:2px; left:0; width:10px; height:16px; border-radius:4px; background:oklch(73.9% 0.177 58.2 / .25); } .ds-rb-base { left:0; right:0; top:50%; height:1px; background:var(--color-fill, oklch(92.2% 0 0)); } .ds-rb-q { top:7px; width:1px; height:6px; background:var(--color-inactive, oklch(87% 0 0)); } .ds-rb-today { top:0; left:0; width:2px; height:20px; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--color-strong, oklch(14.5% 0 0)); } .ds-rb-tick { top:3px; width:3px; height:14px; border-radius:1px; transform:translateX(-50%); background:var(--color-primary, oklch(57.72% 0.2324 260)); } .ds-rb-near { background:var(--color-warning-text, oklch(55% 0.13 57.5)); } .ds-rb-x { top:6px; width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:9999px; transform:translateX(-50%); background:var(--color-surface, #fff); box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--color-primary, oklch(57.72% 0.2324 260)); }

narrative.overview:
Fortify reads like a calm infrastructure console that happens to run an insurance agency. The grammar is the Cloudflare dashboard's (neutral canvas, white working surfaces, hairline rings, one blue, dense 40px tables) with none of Cloudflare's brand: no orange, no cloud, no borrowed name. Neutrals carry nearly the whole interface; color appears only where it means something: the one action blue, and status hues that encode state.

Density is a feature. A Producer or Account Manager should scan forty Accounts and know what is due next without opening one, so rows stay at 40px, numbers sit in tabular figures, and nothing is padded to look airy. The one expressive move is the Term ribbon, a 12-month micro-timeline drawn from data in every row; everything around it stays quiet so it can be read.

The rejected category default is the card grid with colored stage pills and an oversized KPI hero. Light mode only; WCAG 2.2 AA is a floor, and the contrast-corrected tokens below are part of the system, not exceptions to it.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral canvas, white surfaces, 1px ring edges instead of borders.
One accent: action blue, which is also the brand hue.
Inter Variable throughout, 14px base, -0.16px tracking, weights 400/500/600 only.
Status as dot plus label; pills only for counts and plan-like badges.
The Term ribbon as the signature data glyph.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Action Blue is the only accent. It appears on the primary action, focus, links, selection, ribbon ticks and the logomark; nowhere else. Active tabs and active nav use strong neutrals, not blue.

rules.name: The State-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Status hues appear only where they encode state (pipeline stage, policy status, renewal risk) and always beside a text label or icon.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: 400, 500 and 600 only. Nothing light, nothing bold beyond 600.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Counts, money, dates and the meta line use tabular figures; numeric columns align right.

rules.name: The No-Airy-Table Rule
rules.body: Rows are 40px, header row 40px. Never pad a table to look spacious.

rules.name: The Ring Not Border Rule
rules.body: Surfaces get edges from a ring shadow, never a CSS border. 1px `line` borders are reserved for structural shell dividers (top bar bottom, sidebar edge, tab strip, sidebar footer), and `fill` borders for table row dividers.

rules.name: The Two-Edge Rule
rules.body: Cards and tables keep the 0.1 hairline; only form controls get the 0.45 control line.

rules.name: The One Glyph Rule
rules.body: The ribbon is the only expressive element on a list surface. It stays a data glyph: no labels inside it, no color outside blue, warning and neutrals.

dos: Do use Action Blue only for the primary action, focus, links, selection, ribbon ticks and the logomark.
Do give surfaces a 1px ring at 0.1 alpha, and form controls the 0.45 control line.
Do keep rows at 40px and controls at 36px with an 8px radius; 12px only for the global search entry and large panels.
Do show status as a dot plus a 13px label, and keep pills for counts and plan-like badges.
Do use tabular figures and right alignment for numbers, and a muted "—" for empty cells.
Do keep rows in place on refetch with the 2px progress line; show skeletons only on first load after 150ms.
Do carry Office as a "Contact · Office" token for agency-scope roles rather than adding a column.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent, an orange brand color, or Cloudflare's name or mark.
Don't use filled colored pills for stage or policy status.
Don't put CSS borders on cards, tables, controls or popovers; borders are for shell dividers and row dividers only.
Don't use gradients, glass, or shadows outside the Ring, Control and Pop recipes.
Don't use weights other than 400, 500 and 600, or a second display face.
Don't pad tables to look airy, or add entrance animations.
